statement.p: Find the critical points for the function f(x,y) = x^{3}+y^{3}-12x^{2}-27y-1 and classify each as a local maximum, local minimum, saddle point, or none of these.

p.em: (give your points as a comma separated list of (x,y) coordinates.)
(give your answers in a comma separated list, specifying maximum, minimum, saddle point, or none for each, in the same order as you entered your critical points)

static.solution:
f_x = 0 and f_y = 0 for x and y. Solving f_x = 3x^2 - 24 x = 0, we have x = 0 or x = 8. Then f_y = 3y^2 - 27 = 0, so that y = \pm 3. There are four critical points: (0,3), (0,-3), (8,3), and (8,-3).
Then we have D =(f_{xx})(f_{yy}) - (f_{xy})^2 = (6x-24)(6y) - (0)^2 = (6x-24)(6y). At the point (0,3), we have D \lt 0, so f has saddle point.
At the point (0,-3), we have D > 0 and f_{xx} \lt 0, so f has a local maximum.
At the point (8,3), we have D > 0 and f_{xx} > 0, so f has a local minimum.
At the point (8,-3), we have D \lt 0, so f has a saddle point.
